text:
matt lopez: Quick check — planning a canary roll for the feature-flag ff/autoscale/burst_queueing_v2 tonight at 23:00 UTC. Start at 5% traffic for 1h, then 20% for 2h if metrics look good. Guardrails I propose: max_concurrency=120, burst_tokens=500, queue_timeout=45s. Anyone object?

anya singh: quick q — which routes will be in the canary audience? only hosted-api prod traffic or include dedicated customers?

matt lopez: only hosted-api prod for this first smoke (lowest blast radius). we exclude Dedicated and Private. targeting traffic route /v1/generate only.

rui chen: what exact metrics should we watch during the 5% hour? p95 latency, 5xx rate, and queue_length right? give exact thresholds so oncall knows when to flip.

anya singh: +1 on thresholds. suggest: p95 latency increase >200ms over baseline, error rate spike >0.5%, queue_length > 100 for 2 consecutive mins -> rollback. Also watch GPU utilization on pool "burst-pool-01" > 85%.

oncall-bot: FYI: scheduled pager for eng-runtime on-call for 1768905600 -> 1768909200 (23:00-00:00 UTC). Pager will trigger on alert rules: latency-regression, 5xx-spike, gpu-util-high.

sophia lo: Also add a soft alarm: if cost per token increases >15% we should throttle the canary and pause ramp. We don't want runaway cost.

matt lopez: good catches. I'll add those to the rollout checklist. Also plan to set flag toggle with gradual ramp in FF-ninja: 5% -> 20% -> 50% over 24h if stable. Command I'll use:

```
# toggle command (feature-flag service)
ffctl set ff/autoscale/burst_queueing_v2 --env=prod --audience=route:/v1/generate --pct=5 --note="canary 5% 23:00 UTC"
```

rui chen: make sure to attach the canary dashboard and a short runbook link in the ff note. oncall should have quick steps to revert:

```
# rollback
ffctl set ff/autoscale/burst_queueing_v2 --env=prod --pct=0 --note="rollback due to metric X"
```

anya singh: corner case: queue_timeout changed to 45s means some clients with long polling may see aborts. We should announce in #support and add a temporary 429->retry guidance.

matt lopez: good call. I'll post a short note to #support and #customer-success with TTL 12h.

deploy-bot: flag ff/autoscale/burst_queueing_v2 scheduled at 2026-03-17T23:00:00Z by matt lopez (5% initial).

oncall-bot: Alerting rules bound: p95_delta > 0.2s, error_rate_delta > 0.005, queue_len > 100, gpu_util > 0.85, cost_delta_pct > 0.15. Pager threshold set for any 3 of 5 triggers within 5m.

sophia lo: Suggest we include a temporary circuit-breaker: if queue_len > 200 or p99 latency > 2s then auto-set pct=0. deploy-bot can run that.

matt lopez: added auto-rollback lambda to the FF webhook that listens to those alerts. will test in staging tomorrow.

rui chen: will you also tag the rollout PR so SRE and infra can grep traces? PR number?

matt lopez: PR #4821 — includes rollout config and metrics dashboards. tagging @rui and @anya for review.

anya singh: LGTM from product-side. I'll approve the PR after you add the support note.

matt lopez: thanks. last item — if stable after ramp to 20% for 2h with no alerts, plan to push to 50% next day 06:00 UTC. I'll post an update in this thread after the 5% window. :thumbsup:

sophia lo: ack — will monitor cost metrics.

oncall-bot: Reminder scheduled: 1768905600 (canary start) — on-call rota: rui chen.

matt lopez: thanks all — will update when flag is live.
